scope: Primary arXiv metadata and abstracts for recent direct overlaps; full text, code, references, citations, patents, and non-arXiv literature remain mandatory before a novelty claim.

sources.title: Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
sources.relevant_claim: budget-constrained joint optimization of interdependent full-versus-linear attention layer placement using learned gates

sources.title: Sparse Prefix Caching for Hybrid and Recurrent LLM Serving
sources.relevant_claim: distribution-aware exact dynamic-program placement of sparse recurrent-state prefix checkpoints

sources.title: Ada-KV: Optimizing KV Cache Eviction by Adaptive Budget Allocation for Efficient LLM Inference
sources.relevant_claim: head-wise adaptive KV eviction budget allocation guided by an attention-output loss bound

sources.title: SqueezeAttention: 2D Management of KV-Cache in LLM Inference via Layer-wise Optimal Budget
sources.relevant_claim: joint layer-wise and sequence-wise KV budget allocation using measured layer importance

sources.title: Budgeted Attention Allocation: Cost-Conditioned Compute Control for Efficient Transformers
sources.relevant_claim: one checkpoint with monotone attention-head gates conditioned on a requested compute budget

sources.title: Optimizing Native Sparse Attention with Latent Attention and Local Global Alternating Strategies
sources.relevant_claim: alternating local and global sparse-attention layers combined with latent cache representations

overlap_decisions.reason: FlashMorph already formulates placement as interdependent budget-constrained subset optimization and jointly learns layer gates
Ada-KV and SqueezeAttention already allocate cache budgets non-uniformly across heads/layers and sequences
Sparse Prefix Caching already gives an exact distribution-aware checkpoint-placement formulation for recurrent/hybrid models
arXiv:2511.00819 already combines alternating local/global NSA strategies with latent attention
Budgeted Attention Allocation already conditions structural attention usage on a requested cost budget
combining named published components does not create a mechanism, predictive law, or inseparable systems contribution

surviving_hypotheses.statement: A small set of causal information-flow quantities—middle integration contribution, maximum recurrent refresh gap, final readout distance, and all-required-source recall—predicts which from-scratch recurrent/global layer placements preserve language, retrieval, and composition quality at a fixed state/compute budget.
surviving_hypotheses.distinction_to_test: Unlike FlashMorph's task-driven conversion gates, the proposed contribution is an explanatory law fitted on some layouts/scales and prospectively predicting unseen from-scratch layouts, tasks, and scales without architecture search on the held-out cells.
required_baselines: FlashMorph-style jointly optimized gates where reproducibly implementable
surviving_hypotheses.fit_data: discovery layouts only, with diagnostics measured before held-out placement quality is exposed
held_out: unseen dependency templates and source loads
one different recurrent or cache representation
surviving_hypotheses.success: the preregistered law predicts held-out ranking and absolute failure margins materially better than every baseline with uncertainty, and its intervention moves both diagnostics and outcomes as predicted
falsifiers: joint gate optimization matches or beats prediction with no explanatory loss
coefficients change sign across seeds or scales
diagnostic interventions do not move capability
the law reduces to count, FLOPs, or final-layer presence

surviving_hypotheses.statement: For compressed/sparse long-context models, the probability that every causally required route and payload source survives representation and selection predicts multi-hop composition failure more reliably than total dense-attention mass recall, top-k overlap, or single-source retrieval.
surviving_hypotheses.distinction_to_test: The candidate connects selector/compressor diagnostics to constituent-complete composition, not merely attention-output error, cache importance, or single-needle recall.
surviving_hypotheses.fit_data: mechanism-scale route/payload cases with source identities frozen independently of candidate outputs
held_out: unseen graph structures and hop counts
unseen compression rates and selection budgets
surviving_hypotheses.success: the diagnostic prospectively predicts example- and cell-level composition failures beyond baselines, calibrates across scales, and supports causal source-restoration interventions
falsifiers: dense mass or reconstruction error predicts equally well
all-source recall is nearly always one or zero and adds no resolution
selected-source restoration does not recover composition
relationship fails on real multi-document tasks
effect disappears after controlling for distance and load

rejected_or_deferred_hypotheses.reason: exact sparse recurrent-state checkpoint placement is already explicit in arXiv:2605.05219
head-, layer-, sequence-, and requested-budget allocation all have direct prior art

full_landscape_before_claim: read and archive exact full-text versions and licenses for every direct source
audit released code and experiment boundaries where available
follow backward references and forward citations
search arXiv, proceedings, patents, technical reports, and deployed system documentation with recorded queries/dates
obtain independent expert review of the closest-overlap table
evidence_before_claim: freeze the hypothesis and model before held-out results
at least three scales with paired uncertainty
comparison to the strongest direct prior-art method
claim_gate.decision: Paper 1 may claim novelty only if at least one surviving hypothesis clears both the full landscape and held-out evidence gates; otherwise the paper narrows to a replication/systems study or is not positioned as a novel architecture paper.

decision.next_action: complete full-text/code/reference/citation review for N1 and N2, then freeze one prospectively powered held-out falsification protocol before collecting supporting results
